rationale: B wins because it keeps the same strong regulatory, market, investor, and patient shapes while committing fewer facts the update did not give it. A's "Novo Nordisk Spent Years Building the GLP-1 Market" and "Its First Big Move" are reporter bait built on assumptions; B's "The FDA has flagged compounded GLP-1s. Hims & Hers is scaling them anyway." stays closer to the record. B still has a wobbly diagnostics angle, but it marks the proof needed instead of pretending the feature is already a trend.
gaps_in_A: "Novo Nordisk Spent Years Building the GLP-1 Market" names Novo Nordisk and later Eli Lilly even though the update only says "branded manufacturers." That is outside the given facts.

"Its First Big Move Carries FDA Risk" overclaims. The update says Hims recently turned profitable and is launching this service; it does not say this is the first major strategic move after profitability.
"clearest test case yet" is a little too grand. Good instinct, bad certainty; the facts support a test case, not the clearest one.

A refuses the lab-testing angle a bit too hard. The feature lacks proof, yes, but "at-home blood testing to personalize treatment" can support a conditional digital-health/care-model angle if the workflow is real.
gaps_in_B: "With at-home blood tests, telehealth moves from writing prescriptions to running diagnostics" overstates the fact. The update says Hims added at-home blood testing to personalize treatment, not that it is broadly "running diagnostics."
"drugmakers want it stopped" is sharper than the supplied fact. "Pushed back" could mean legal threats, lobbying, public warnings, or something softer; the angle needs the actual form of pushback.
"The launch is a one-day peg" is too cramped for the counterposition angle. Manufacturer pushback plus FDA risk can live longer than launch day if there is a filing, statement, or enforcement hook.
"Next step: journalist-fit-check" comes too early. The right next move is proof collection first: supplier, price, legal basis, and lab workflow. Names can wait.
